aria-hidden only hides content from assistive tech, not visually — it must still be rendered

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<p>visible</p><div aria-hidden=\"true\">still shown</div><p>also visible</p>");
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
